channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques autoriza retorno ao ar de 9 rádios ligadas a JHC em Alagoas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques overturned a decision by the Alagoas Regional Electoral Court that had suspended nine radio stations and ten social media profiles suspected of illegally supporting João Henrique Caldas (PSDB) in the state gubernatorial race. The measures were based on investigations into irregular electoral use of media outlets. The decision keeps the radios on air while further analysis is conducted.

item.title: Brasil tenta se blindar de interferência dos EUA nas Eleições 2026, diz NYT
item.description: Brazil is implementing measures to safeguard the 2026 elections from potential U.S. interference, particularly following Donald Trump's strategies in Latin America. Authorities are tracking disinformation, foreign lobbying, and false fraud claims, while countries like the EU and Canada prepare to support the electoral process integrity.

item.title: Janja: Flávio quer atribuir a Lula “rótulo” que pertence aos Bolsonaros
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for attempting to associate President Lula with a supposed scandal involving child abuse, labeling it an effort to shift the negative image of the Bolsonaro family onto the PT. She highlighted controversial statements by Jair Bolsonaro and allegations against Alfredo Gaspar, reinforcing the tone of direct confrontation between the campaigns.

item.title: Renan Santos protesta na Globo e acusa Flávio Bolsonaro de vetá-lo
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate from Missão, protested outside TV Globo after being excluded from the final presidential debate before the first round, accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of vetoing his participation. The analysis on Papo Antagonista highlighted the candidate's speech, his high rejection rate, and the attempt to control the vote.

item.title: Lula confirma entrevista ao podcast ‘Flow’ no mesmo dia de debate na ‘Globo’
item.description: Lula decided not to attend the presidential debate on TV Globo and will instead give an interview to the Flow podcast on the same day. The interview is scheduled for 8:45 PM, while the debate starts at 9:30 PM. Lula justified his absence by disagreeing with the debate format, according to close sources.

item.title: Eduardo ameaça agir contra diplomatas que "sabotaram" governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro threatened Itamaraty officials he accused of sabotaging his father Jair Bolsonaro's government. He pledged to investigate and dismiss diplomats if his brother Flávio Bolsonaro is elected president. The video followed reports of alleged support from the Brazilian embassy in Spain for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's son.

item.title: Haddad volta a citar combate ao Comando Vermelho em cidades de SP durante agenda na capital
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), running for governor of São Paulo, addressed the fight against the Comando Vermelho and PCC during his campaign in the capital, proposing a new anti-gang agency supported by the Federal Police and IRS. He also criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for not accounting for the film ‘Dark Horse’. A Quaest poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading at 44% and Haddad at 24%.

item.title: ‘Toque’: Estela Aranha determina remoção de post de Nikolas que associa Lula a crimes contra crianças
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha ordered the removal of a post by congressman Nikolas Ferreira that linked Lula to crimes against children, deeming it out of context and potentially damaging to the candidate's image. The coalition Brazil Ready for More filed the lawsuit arguing misuse of a public statement by Lula about medical exams. The decision aims to prevent electoral misinformation that could mislead voters.

item.title: Em últimas propagandas no rádio, Lula ataca Flávio, que aposta em "virada"
item.description: In final radio ads, Lula attacks Flávio over alleged militia ties, while Flávio promotes a 'turnaround' message backed by Tarcísio and Michelle. First round is on October 4th.

item.title: Lula confirma ida ao Flow no mesmo horário do debate da Globo
item.description: Lula confirmed his participation in Flow Podcast on Thursday, 1st, at the same time TV Globo will host the final presidential debate before the first round. His choice appears strategic to attract younger voters and avoid direct confrontations with opponents. The topic to be discussed is the future of Brazil, with no specific political agenda defined.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra como está a corrida Lula x Flávio no terceiro maior colégio eleitoral do Centro-Oeste
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the Federal District with 38% vs 32% in first-round vote intentions for 2026. In a hypothetical second round, Flávio maintains the advantage with 48% against Lula's 37%. The survey, commissioned by Globo, sampled 1,104 voters between September 25-28 with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Fachin que tire Dino de processos ligados à eleição
item.description: Lawyers for Flávio Bolsonaro requested the STF president, Edson Fachin, to suspend cases handled by Minister Flávio Dino related to elections, Lula, or investigations into the film Dark Horse, alleging closeness between the minister and the PT leader. The motion seeks to declare Dino suspect and reassign the cases, except when a rapporteur is already defined. The defense argues that a combination of acts demonstrates a close personal relationship between Dino and Lula.

item.title: Jean Wyllys pede suspeição de Nunes Marques em caso de post sobre Flávio
item.description: Jean Wyllys requested the recusal of Justice Nunes Marques at the TSE regarding a post involving Flávio Bolsonaro and the Banco Master scandal. Defense argues conflict with earlier withdrawal from a Supreme Court case. The September 28 ruling ordered removal of the content under penalty of fine.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (30) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Wednesday (30), presidential candidates carried out campaign activities such as walks, parades, and interviews. Ronaldo Caiado emphasized the advancement of Artificial Intelligence with open code, while Augusto Cury defended the reduction of public spending and the Selic rate. Other candidates like Samara Martins and Hertz Dias also promoted their campaigns in different states.

item.title: Candidatos da 'terceira via' buscam espaço na reta final e miram debate da Globo
item.description: Four days ahead of the first round of the 2026 elections, third-way presidential candidates seek to carve out space and influence the final Globo debate. Figures such as Ronaldo Caiado, Augusto Cury, and Renan Santos play varied roles, with some defending democracy and criticizing polarization, while others legally challenge their exclusion from the debate. The electoral context reflects an attempt to break from the dominance of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, though with difficulties in mobilizing votes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao STF que Dino seja afastado de casos envolvendo ele, Lula e eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense team asked the STF to remove Minister Flávio Dino from cases involving the senator, Lula, and the 2026 election, citing partiality. The request was submitted to STF President Edson Fachin with a motion for a preliminary injunction. The strategy aims to preserve judicial impartiality and the image of the Court.

item.title: A eleição e a República
item.description: The text criticizes the worn-out Brazilian political scene, highlighting public dissatisfaction, polarization and lack of concrete proposals from candidates. It advocates for changes such as age limits for candidacies, limited re-election and greater youth participation.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede a evangélicos orações pelo presidente até fim da apuração no 1º turno
item.description: Lula's campaign urges evangelical supporters to pray for the president until the first-round vote count concludes, using a 'prayer clock'. The initiative mirrors 2022 tactics and amplifies religious issues in the election, including misinformation about the Virgin of Aparecida.

item.title: Mais da metade dos brasileiros ainda não decidiu voto para o Legislativo
item.description: Datafolha poll reveals that 59% of Brazilians have not yet decided their vote for senator or legislative deputies. Electoral uncertainty persists with just days left before the first round on October 4th. This scenario reflects low voter definition regarding candidates running for legislative seats.

item.title: Embaixador ajudou lobista em mudança de Lulinha para Madri
item.description: Messages released on September 30, 2026 revealed that the Brazilian ambassador in Madrid, Orlando Leite Ribeiro, assisted lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger in relocating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, to Spain in 2025. The relationship between Luchsinger and Lulinha had already been politically exploited by the opposition, and the case gained renewed attention near the end of the 2026 election cycle. The MRE denied irregularities, but the conversations suggest more than routine diplomatic support.

item.title: Leonardo Avalanche desiste da candidatura ao Planalto
item.description: Leonardo Avalanche, national president of PRTB, withdrew his candidacy for the Presidential Palace. The announcement came one day after Pablo Marçal, from the same party, attended an event with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula confirma entrevista ao podcast Flow no mesmo horário do debate da TV Globo
item.description: Lula confirms podcast Flow interview at the same time as the Globo debate, opting out of the televised confrontation. His absence was justified by aides, while allies weighed the risks of exposing his leadership in the race against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Chuva impede deslocamento de helicóptero, e Lula cancela ato em Juiz de Fora
item.description: President Lula canceled a campaign event in Juiz de Fora due to heavy rains that prevented his helicopter transport. The agenda included appearances by Petro candidates in Minas Gerais, including Patrus Ananias and Marília Campos, as part of efforts to mobilize voters before the first round. According to a Quaest poll, Lula leads technically over Flávio Bolsonaro in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Metade do fundo eleitoral fica nas mãos de 5% dos candidatos
item.description: Half of the R$4.95 billion electoral fund was concentrated among just 5% of candidates, according to TSE data. Lula leads with R$55 million, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro and Fernando Haddad. This concentration favors established politicians, hindering political renewal.

item.title: Promoção alcança 11 mil policiais em SP a 5 dias da eleição e beneficia até preso por sequestro
item.description: The São Paulo government promoted 11,230 police officers five days before the election, including those investigated or arrested for serious crimes such as kidnapping and corruption. The automatic promotion, based on a law signed by Tarcísio de Freitas, increases salaries and benefits but raises concerns about criteria and impunity.

item.title: Brasil ergue barreira para tentar proteger eleição de interferência dos EUA, diz New York Times
item.description: Brazil has taken steps to protect the 2026 elections from potential U.S. interference, including monitoring foreign lobbying, fighting disinformation, and coordinating internationally after the vote. Authorities aim to safeguard the integrity of the national electoral process amid concerns about external influence.

item.title: Justiça proíbe coordenador da Secom de Lula de fazer posts sobre eleições nas redes sociais
item.description: The Electoral Court banned Georges Marques, head of Strategy and Information at the Presidency's Communications Secretariat, from making political-electoral posts on social media until the end of the second round. The judge opened an investigation into alleged false posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to a project to revoke Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patron saint. Although the judge found evidence of spreading misinformation, he rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request for preventive arrest. The Secretariat deemed the ruling arbitrary, citing censorship of free speech.

item.title: Flávio pede ao STF que Dino fique fora de casos ligados a Lula
item.description: Lawyers for Flávio Bolsonaro filed a request with the STF asking Minister Flávio Dino to be declared recused in cases involving Lula, the 2026 elections, and the senator himself, citing partiality. The petition seeks to prevent Dino from judging cases where Lula is a party.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que estará 'na cola' de diplomatas que teriam 'sabotado' o governo do pai caso Flávio seja eleito
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro stated in a social media video that he will closely monitor ambassadors and MRE officials who allegedly “sabotaged” his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government if his brother Flávio Bolsonaro is elected president. He played an audio attributed to lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and criticized what he calls preferential treatment for Lula’s family by Brazilian diplomats abroad. The former lawmaker also pledged to overhaul the structure of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Kássio e Toffoli acompanham Mendonça sobre N. S. Aparecida; placar está em 3 a 0
item.description: TSE ministers Kássio and Toffoli upheld Minister Mendonça's decision to remove 1,125 social media posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to a bill seeking to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of its title as Brazil's patron saint. The measure aims to combat disinformation during the election.

item.title: Tarifaço chinês à carne brasileira: saiba o que dizem os jornais de China, Argentina e Uruguai
item.description: China imposed a 67% tariff on Brazilian beef after Brazil filled its quota of 1.106 million tons in September, making exports unviable for Brazilian processors. The Lula government is seeking alternatives, while Uruguay and Argentina, subject to lower quotas, have not filled them and may benefit from rising prices. Chinese media follows an official stance, whereas Argentine outlets highlight a temporary opportunity for local exporters.

item.title: Michelle responde a Janja em ato: “Bolsonara de Ceilândia com orgulho”
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, a Senate candidate from the PL party, expressed pride in being the 'Bolsonara of Ceilândia' during a caravan rally supporting Celina Leão (PP), indirectly responding to First Lady Janja Lula, who criticized her for carrying the Bolsonaro surname. The exchange followed Janja's remarks two weeks earlier at a PT event in Ceilândia, urging voters not to support candidates associated with Bolsonarism.

item.title: JOTA fará cobertura ao vivo das Eleições 2026, com análises da apuração em tempo real
item.description: JOTA will provide live coverage of the 2026 election results starting at 4 PM on YouTube and its website, featuring real-time analysis and expert commentary in politics, economics, and data science. Over 158.7 million eligible voters will participate in this first round beginning at 8 AM, with polling stations closing at 5 PM (Brasília time). The broadcast will include on-site reporters and live segments for continuous updates.

item.title: A fé é livre. A democracia também deveria ser
item.description: The article criticizes the use of religious faith as an electoral campaign tool, warning about the loss of dialogue and increased polarization. It advocates for democracy to respect religious freedom and Brazil's religious pluralism, and that religious leaders should not pressure voters. It concludes with a call for informed voters and a conscientious vote based on proposals, not manipulation.

item.title: Lula dará entrevista ao Flow no dia do debate da “TV Globo”
item.description: President Lula will give an interview to the Flow podcast on the same day as the Globo debate, which he will not attend. His absence is due to a strategy to avoid criticism from right-wing candidates, repeating a tactic used in 2006.

item.title: TSE tem 3 votos a 1 para manter remoção de posts sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld, by a 3-to-1 vote, the decision of Minister André Mendonça to remove posts that falsely linked presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to an alleged effort to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as patron saint of Brazil.

item.title: Evangélicos são alvo de disputa, mas rejeitam uso eleitoral de igrejas
item.description: Despite the prominent role of evangelical voters in the 2026 political landscape, most reject the use of churches for campaigning or religious leaders indicating votes. A Iser survey shows 83% of Brazilians oppose pastors and priests influencing voting decisions, highlighting a desire to keep faith and citizenship separate.

item.title: Campanha de Lula busca associar caso de menina morta por PM a Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign begins addressing the case of Ana Clara Machado, killed by a policeman defended by lawyer Flávio Bolsonaro, attempting to associate the PL candidate with this tragedy. The highlighted piece on social media questions voting for someone who defends a 'child murderer'.

item.title: Justiça nega prisão de servidor da Secom acusado de fake news sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The Federal District Electoral Court denied preventive arrest of George Marques, a government communications official accused by Flávio Bolsonaro of spreading false claims about the Virgin of Aparecida. While acknowledging the offense, the judge imposed social media restrictions and flagged potential electoral violations.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': PF faz nova perícia em material apreendido pela Polícia Civil de SP por ordem de Flávio Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to conduct a new forensic analysis of materials seized by the São Paulo Civil Police in the 'Wi-Fi Operation,' which investigates alleged misuse of funds for the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. Businesswoman Karina da Gama and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro are under investigation for suspected money laundering and misuse of public resources.

item.title: Vídeo: Cury diz ter sido procurado por Lula e Flávio por apoio no 2º turno
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) stated he was approached by members of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns for support in a potential runoff, but declined, asserting he will run until the end. Despite polling in third place, Cury rejected the notion of a 'third way' and emphasized his independence.

item.title: Deputado que foi vice-presidente do Flamengo tenta alterar MP das bets para tirar apostas esportivas da proibição
item.description: Deputy Marcos Braz (PSDB-RJ) proposed amendments to modify the provisional measure banning betting companies, suggesting the exclusion of sports betting from the prohibition and a two-year period for football clubs to maintain sponsorship contracts. The MP, issued by the federal government, has a temporary validity of four months and must be voted on by Congress within 120 days.

item.title: TSE tem placar de 3 a 1 para manter remoção de posts sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The TSE upheld, by a 3-2 vote, the removal of posts regarding the controversy over revoking the title of Patron Saint from Our Lady of Aparecida. Justices such as Nunes Marques and Toffoli supported Mendonça's decision, while Cueva and Floriano voted to limit the action only to content attributing concrete acts to Flávio Bolsonaro. The case sparked tensions in the STF, with discussions on jurisdiction and institutional backlash.

item.title: A decisão de Lula sobre participação no debate da Globo
item.description: President Lula decided not to participate in the last Globo debate before the first round, maintaining his absence from all confrontations. Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Cury and Zema are confirmed; Lula avoids debates to not expose his weak performance.

item.title: TSE tem placar de 3×1 para manter decisão de Mendonça que derrubou publicações sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: The TSE upheld Mendonça's ruling to remove false publications linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the removal of Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, with a 3-1 vote. The decision targets only factually false content, without censoring religious debates or criticism of the candidate.

item.title: Mendes fala em ‘temperatura elevada’ e critica uso político de investigações no STF
item.description: Gilmar Mendes implicitly criticized André Mendonça's handling of investigations at the STF during a tribute speech to Edson Fachin, emphasizing the need to maintain judicial impartiality and avoid political exploitation of probes. Mendes praised Fachin's balanced approach in the Car Wash operation and stressed the importance of serenity in the Court to improve service to the Brazilian people.

item.title: Renan Santos vai ao TSE para tentar participar de debate na ‘Globo’
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate from the Missão party for the Presidency, asked the TSE to force Globo to invite him to Thursday's presidential debate, claiming the broadcaster had generated expectations about his participation. The request will be reviewed by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques and follows a similar ruling requiring Globo to include Romeu Zema in the debate.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que Flávio Bolsonaro 'não é tanto de direita' e o situa 'até para a esquerda'
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, stated in an interview with the podcast Inteligência Ltda. that Flávio Bolsonaro is not so right-wing and placed him between the center and the left. He also criticized President Lula for raising the Bolsa Família near election time and suggested hiring figures like Leandro Daiello for security roles.

item.title: Da pergunta sobre Deus a FHC à cadeirada de Datena: 5 debates que marcaram as eleições brasileiras
item.description: The 2026 Globo presidential debate will be the second before the first round, but Lula will not participate. BBC coverage highlights five landmark debates in recent history, including FHC's 'God question' and Datena's chair incident, reflecting how debate relevance has evolved.

item.title: André Mendonça derruba decisão que havia suspendido propaganda de chapa de Ciro Gomes no Ceará
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça overturned an injunction that had suspended electoral advertising for Ciro Gomes' ticket in Ceará, restoring TV and radio time for the Union Progressive alliance candidates. The ruling reversed restrictions imposed by minister Flôrigo Marques, responding to challenges regarding the alliance between União Brasil and PP with Ciro Gomes, which contradicted previous support for Elmano de Freitas. The decision restored advertising rights and party funding access for candidates Roberto Cláudio, Captain Wagner, Prisco Bezerra, and Lúcio Gomes.
